ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which image represents Large Ground Finch?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image has side views of two bird heads labeled A and B. A's bird beak is very large, deep, and thick, appearing suitable for crushing seeds; B's bird beak is smaller, thinner, and sharper. Reasoning: The typical feature of the Large Ground Finch (large ground finch) is having a larger, sturdy, powerful beak, used to break open larger seeds. Therefore, the one matching this feature is A.
